scientific_question: How often can the frozen native MCES sample be proved optimal when the sparse lifted MILP budget is extended from 10 seconds to 300 and 1800 seconds?
sampling: 25 numeric-test-order positions per dataset: round(linspace(0, N-1, 25)); independent of outcomes.

reporting.primary: certified-optimal proportion with an exact Clopper-Pearson 95% interval
reporting.secondary: median relative gap and proportions with gap at most 1%, 5%, and 10%
reporting.monotone_envelope: At each budget, combine every legal incumbent and valid dual upper bound available at that or any smaller budget.

hard_subset_rule: Among pairs certified optimal by 1800 seconds, retain pairs on which both frozen RASCAL-60s and matched NGA return fewer common edges than the certified optimum.
